text: Which negative prefix? Im before m and p: immature, impatient. Il before l: illegal, illiterate. Ir before r: irregular, irresponsible. In before most others: inactive, invisible. And un with most plain English words: unhappy, unknown. When in doubt, un is the safest guess.
